observations: Four photos show large bundles of clothing wrapped in plastic and secured with green straps.
The bundles are tightly packed and appear to contain multiple garments of various colors and patterns.
The clothing is not visible through the plastic wrap; only the outer layers are shown.
No individual garments are visible, and no labels or tags are readable on the clothing itself.
The seller's text claims 'UK first-grade clothing', but no proof of origin or quality is visible in the photos.

claims.evidence: No visible labels, tags, or markings on the clothing to confirm origin or quality. The photos show only the outer layers of the bundles.
Quality and style cannot be assessed from the photos alone. Affordability is subjective and not verifiable remotely.

risks.risk: The clothing may be of poor quality or not as advertised (e.g., not UK-made, not first-grade)
risks.proof: Close-up photos of individual garments showing fabric type, stitching, tags, and any labels indicating origin or quality.
risks.if_unproven: priced as lower quality or generic, not premium

risks.risk: The clothing may be damaged, stained, or worn inside the plastic wrap
risks.proof: Photos of the inside of the plastic wrap showing the condition of the garments, including any stains, tears, or wear.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially damaged or used

risks.risk: The bundle may contain only used or second-hand clothing, not new or high-quality items
risks.proof: Photos of the inside of the bundle showing the condition of the garments, including any tags, labels, or signs of wear.
risks.if_unproven: priced as used or second-hand, not new

proof_requests: Close-up photos of individual garments inside the plastic wrap, showing fabric, stitching, and any tags or labels.
Photos of the inside of the plastic wrap to check for stains, tears, or wear.
Photos of any tags or labels on the clothing to verify origin or quality.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
